title: Pink Workwear for a Freezing Office
intro: Every office has one thermostat and it is set for penguins. This is the fix: a soft pink cable knit cardigan over beige wide leg trousers, black penny loafers you can walk to the train in, pearl and gold studs, a leather laptop tote that fits the laptop and the charger, and a hot pink insulated tumbler that keeps the coffee hot through the ten o'clock meeting. Soft and pink was never the opposite of competent. Save it for the next long Monday.

items.name: Hot pink 40 oz insulated tumbler with handle
